name: mining_annual_value
note: Invented practice case: predictive-maintenance value at a fictional copper mine.

request.question: What is the annual value of deploying this model?
context_turns: Me: Assume a true alert converts an unplanned repair into a planned one.
stated_figures: Me: The fleet has 120 haul trucks.
Me: Trucks experience 3.2 unplanned failures per truck per year.
Me: The mean unplanned downtime per failure is 26 hours.
Me: When the same repair is done as planned maintenance, downtime is 8 hours.
Me: Each hour a truck is down costs the mine 4,200 dollars in lost contribution margin.
Me: Suppose that at the chosen alert threshold, the model catches 55% of failures, and 40% of the alerts it raises are genuine.
Me: And a false alert costs 3 hours of inspection downtime plus 1,500 dollars in labor and parts.
